method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: FOMO fuels Wall Street's breakout rally as traders pile in
Equities.reason: Market-wide narrative: momentum/FOMO driving broad risk-on behaviour and breakout in major indices. High relevance to equities regime and flows, so strongly positive.

Equities.title: J.P. Morgan lifts 2026-end target for S&P 500 to 8,000 on AI, earnings strength
Equities.reason: Major sell-side bullish re-rating explicitly tied to AI and earnings strength; reinforces risk-on/AI leadership narrative and raises market-level upside expectations.

Equities.title: S&P 500 futures rise as traders watch for Strait of Hormuz deal, inflation data
Equities.reason: Near-term risk tone: futures up but traders focused on geopolitics (Hormuz) and inflation — mildly positive for stocks but conditional on incoming macro and geopolitical developments.

Equities.title: Berkshire earnings rose last quarter and CEO Greg Abel is starting to deploy Buffett's massive cash hoard
Equities.summary: Strength across its energy, railroad and manufacturing businesses more than offset weaker insurance results.
Equities.reason: Berkshire is market-significant: underlying operational strength supports the broader earnings narrative, modestly positive for equities.

Equities.title: Abel puts a big chunk of Berkshire's cash to work
Equities.summary: In his second quarter as the new CEO of Berkshire Hathaway, Greg Abel did some serious spending, including $4.5 billion on buybacks.
Equities.reason: Large buybacks from a marquee household-name boost net demand and signal management confidence — constructive for market liquidity and sentiment.

Equities.title: China Unleashes $28 Trillion Capital Markets to Challenge US in AI
Equities.reason: Large-scale China capital markets push into AI reinforces thematic, multi-year AI leadership and cap-market competition narratives that are driving sector and index flows.

Equities.title: Leveraged ETF Boom Creates New Ways to Profit From Sudden Bursts of Volatility
Equities.reason: Market-structure story: growth of leveraged ETFs amplifies intraday momentum and FOMO, supporting rapid risk-on moves but also increasing fragility — net positive for short-term equities flows.

Equities.title: Hugging Face hack marks start of dangerous AI cyber era and many firms 'don't even know it'
Equities.summary: The Black Hat cybersecurity conference in Las Vegas couldn't have come at a better time, with AI agent hacks stacking up from Anthropic, Meta and OpenAI.
Equities.reason: Cybersecurity incidents tied to AI raise risk concerns for AI-exposed names; included as a lower-relevance counterpoint to the dominant AI tailwind.

Rates.title: Philippine Central Bank Keeps Rate Hike on Table Despite Weak GDP Growth
Rates.reason: Central bank signalling that hikes remain on the table supports a higher-for-longer EM rates narrative; likely to put upward pressure on local yields and risk premium, negative for bonds.

Rates.title: Australian Dollar: RBA set to hold amid inflation risks - BNY
Rates.summary: BNY’s Geoff Yu and David Tam expect the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) to keep rates unchanged at 4.35%, noting that markets doubt its willingness to hike despite persistent inflation and robust labor and spending data.
Rates.reason: Market view of an RBA hold (despite inflation) is modestly supportive for bond prices (yields steadier/lower), but signal is local and lower power for global rates.

Rates.title: Wall St Week Ahead Inflation data to test record-setting US stocks, Fed rate views
Rates.reason: US inflation prints are a primary driver of Fed expectations; the piece frames a test of Fed rate views. A hotter print would push yields up and reinforce higher-for-longer pricing — negative for bonds.

Rates.title: Payrolls miss cuts Fed hike odds as Asia rallies and oil firms on Hormuz stalemate
Rates.reason: Payrolls outcome that reduces odds of rate cuts (or raises odds of hikes), combined with geopolitical oil risk, supports higher yields — negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Behind Bessent Moves, Wall Street Sees Sign of Bond-Market Angst
Rates.reason: Headline signalling 'bond-market angst' points to broader selloff/volatility in core rates markets. Material negative for bond prices and signals higher risk premia and yields.

Rates.title: (BOJ Review) Impact of the Bank of Japan's Reductions in JGB Purchases on the JGB Markets
Rates.reason: BOJ analysis of reduced JGB purchases directly speaks to central-bank-driven supply/demand in the JGB market; lower BOJ buying has been associated with higher yields and JGB volatility — negative for bonds.

Rates.title: Summary of Opinions at the Monetary Policy Meeting on July 30 and 31, 2026
Rates.reason: BOJ meeting opinions are a direct input into JGB and global rates pricing; recent communication has leaned toward reduced accommodation and market-sensitive operations, supporting higher yields.

Rates.title: TD Cowen sees 25% chance Trump will succeed removing Fed’s Cook
Rates.reason: Political risk to Fed leadership raises policy uncertainty and could affect perceived commitment to current policy path; modestly negative for bond market given potential for shifts in policy stance or volatility.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar weakens as US Dollar strengthens on rising risk aversion
FX.summary: USD/CAD gains ground after registering over 0.5% losses in the previous day, trading around 1.3950 during the early European hours on Monday. The pair gains ground as the US Dollar (USD) strengthens on rising safe-haven demand, driven by heightened geopolitica
FX.reason: Clear USD safe-haven bid pushing USD/CAD higher (CAD weakening). USD-driven, geopolitics-related move is meaningful for G10 FX flows and CAD cyclicality, so moderately high relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee drops as Iran sets new Hormuz reopening conditions
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) is down against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR pair rebounds to near 95.25 as oil prices extend their recovery move and the US Dollar regains ground after a weak Friday.
FX.reason: USD strengthening and firmer oil are driving USD/INR higher. Relevant for EMFX flows given oil/import-price transmission, but single-market/commodity linkage keeps relevance below top tier.

FX.title: Euro holds gains near seven-week highs as economic sentiment improves
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) ticks higher against a softer US Dollar (USD) on Monday, with the EUR/USD pair trading at the 1.1560 area at the time of writing, consolidating gains a few pips below seven-week highs at 1.1773.
FX.reason: EUR/USD strength driven by improving Eurozone sentiment and a softer USD. Broad-currency move vs USD is market-regime relevant, so moderate-high relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar: Softer labour data shifts Fed outlook – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale’s Kenneth Broux reports that weaker US employment data and downward revisions have sharply reduced expectations for a September Fed hike, though one move remains priced for December.
FX.reason: Macro USD driver: weaker US labour data reduces near-term Fed tightening odds, implying broader USD softness and potential rally in USD‑pairs (EUR/USD, AUD/USD). Important macro datapoint so high relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Decline to accelerate below 99.40
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) edges up against its peers on Monday after a vertical decline on Friday. At press time, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trades marginally higher to near 99.70.
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast on DXY pointing to further USD weakness. Treated as lower-relevance because it's a technical forecast rather than fresh macro or policy news.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar stalls below 0.5900 as US Dollar regains safe-haven appeal
FX.summary: NZD/USD trades around 0.5895 on Monday at the time of writing, virtually unchanged on the day.
FX.reason: USD safe-haven bid is weighing on NZD/USD. Relevant for risk-sensitive G10 FX but not a headline policy shift, so modest relevance.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: Hawkish RBA hold supports carry – BBH
FX.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s Elias Haddad notes that the Australian Dollar (AUD) remains one of the most attractive G10 currencies thanks to favorable carry and a hawkish Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA).
FX.reason: Fundamental RBA-driven AUD positivity (carry/hawkish hold) supports AUD/USD. Policy-driven G10 flow is directly FX-relevant with moderate relevance.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention credibility questioned – BNY
FX.summary: BNY’s Geoff Yu and David Tam highlight that USD/JPY is grinding higher again after Japan’s recent intervention, with the Japanese Yen (JPY) having already surrendered much of its gains.
FX.reason: Direct FX policy event: intervention flagged but effectiveness questioned, implying persistent JPY weakness and continued USD strength. High relevance given coordination and potential market-regime impact.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention faces persistent rate gap – HSBC
FX.summary: HSBC Asset Management reviews recent coordinated intervention by Japanese and US authorities to support the Japanese Yen, recalling the sharp carry-trade unwind during the previous episode two years ago.
FX.reason: Confirms intervention versus a persistent policy/rate differential; implies limited effectiveness and continued JPY pressure. High relevance as it reinforces a major FX policy narrative.

FX.title: Yen Underperforms G-10 Peers as Intervention Boost Fades
FX.reason: Headline indicates the post-intervention uplift for JPY is fading and JPY is underperforming — fits the dominant narrative of persistent JPY weakness. Included as a market-confirming piece; summary provided empty so treated as title-driven.

Commodities.title: Gold Holds Above $4,300 as Soft Jobs Data Trims Rate-Hike Bets
Commodities.reason: Macro-driven boost to precious metals: softer US jobs/trimmed rate-hike bets lower real yields and increase demand for gold as a rates hedge. High relevance as it reflects the dominant cross-market driver for gold prices.

Commodities.title: Gold drifts lower from seven-week peak, US inflation data looms
Commodities.reason: Near-term price caution ahead of key US inflation data. Mildly positive overall for gold because the item centers on macro data-driven volatility rather than structural weakness; lower relevance due to short-term/ambiguous tone.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $64.24 per troy ounce, up 1.08% from the $63.55 it cost on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Silver following broader metals rally as US rate expectations ease; positive short-term momentum but lower relevance vs. macro gold narrative. Primary driver is rates/liquidity rather than metal-specific demand shock.

Commodities.title: Copper Holds $14,000 as Weaker US Rate Outlook Boosts Metals
Commodities.reason: Weaker US rate outlook supports industrial metals via lower financing costs and improved risk sentiment. Positive for copper prices and relevant as part of a metals-wide macro signal.

Commodities.title: Wheat Hits Highest in a Week on Supply Disruptions in Black Sea
Commodities.reason: Supply-side shock from Black Sea disruptions lifts wheat risk premium and prices. High relevance: direct physical supply constraints in a primary production/export region materially affect the crop market.

Commodities.title: Australian Wheat Crop Rebounds at Crucial Time for Global Supply
Commodities.reason: Countervailing supply improvement from a major exporter reduces some downside risk for prices. Lower relevance since it is a regional production update partially offsetting Black Sea disruption.

Commodities.title: Oil rises as uncertainty continues over reopening of Strait
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical-driven supply risk around the Strait of Hormuz is elevating oil risk premia and pushing prices higher. Strong relevance due to material impact on seaborne flows and immediate market tightness.

Commodities.title: China's crude oil imports fell in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: China, the world's largest importer of crude oil, imported less crude oil in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) following higher crude oil prices that resulted from disrupted flows through the Strait of Hormuz. China's lower imports reduced global demand, softe
Commodities.reason: Demand-side drag from a fall in China crude imports reduces near-term oil demand growth. Relevant as it offsets some of the geopolitical-driven supply premium and moderates net oil price pressure.

Commodities.title: Brent: Iran talks keep risk premium in focus – Deutsche Bank
Commodities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight that negotiations between Iran and Oman over a new shipping framework through the Strait of Hormuz remain finely balanced, with Tehran linking any lasting arrangement to broader demands on the US.
Commodities.reason: Negotiations over Strait shipping arrangements keep a premium on Brent/sea-borne oil due to the risk of protracted disruption. Reinforces the geopolitical supply-risk narrative for oil with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Resolution Copper awards $110m contracts for Arizona mine
Commodities.reason: Project-level capex and contracts suggest future supply additions for copper, a modest long-term negative for prices. Low relevance — idiosyncratic and long-dated vs. near-term macro drivers lifting copper.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin investors pour $853 million into spot ETFs. BlackRock’s IBIT claims the bulk
Crypto.reason: Large spot-BTC ETF inflows are a direct, high-conviction institutional demand signal for Bitcoin — bullish for crypto prices and liquidity. BlackRock capturing the bulk amplifies the trend toward institutional consolidation into ETFs.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin tops $65,000 with U.S. inflation data due this week
Crypto.reason: Bitcoin price breakout above $65k signals momentum and risk-on positioning ahead of macro data; supports the narrative that macro catalysts and ETF flows are driving BTC strength.

Crypto.title: US Senate advances landmark crypto bill before heading on August recess
Crypto.reason: Progress on major U.S. crypto legislation (regulatory clarity) materially reduces policy risk for institutional players and ETFs — a structurally positive development for crypto markets.

Crypto.title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month
Crypto.reason: Moves on the Clarity Act reinforce the regulatory-clarity narrative; supportive but somewhat redundant with other legislative coverage, so slightly lower relevance.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin holders risk losing real BTC if they sell coins from BIP-110 fork, says developer
Crypto.reason: Controversial soft-fork attempts and forked-coin counterparty risk create technical and market-structure uncertainty for BTC holders and exchanges — a negative for market confidence.

Crypto.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers
Crypto.reason: Repeated infrastructure exploits (Lightning node drains) raise systemic security concerns and can impair merchant/payment adoption and on‑ramps — meaningfully negative for crypto risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Brazil's central bank orders exchanges to delay large crypto transfers abroad
Crypto.reason: Capital‑flow restrictions on crypto transfers by a major EM central bank are a direct negative for cross‑border liquidity and institutional flows, increasing regional regulatory risk.

Crypto.title: Bybit sues North Korea and Lazarus Group over $1.5 billion hack, secures asset freeze
Crypto.reason: Legal action and asset freezes against state‑backed hackers improve remediation prospects and signal stronger enforcement/response mechanisms — modestly positive for market trust.

Crypto.title: Inside stablecoin firm BVNK’s journey to a $1.8B acquisition by Mastercard
Crypto.reason: A major payments player acquiring a stablecoin infrastructure firm is a structural positive for on‑ and off‑ramp capabilities and mainstream institutional adoption of crypto rails.

Crypto.title: U.S. widens Iran crypto crackdown with sanctions on two exchanges
Crypto.reason: Expanded sanctions on exchanges increase compliance costs and constrain certain cross‑border crypto flows, adding regulatory friction — a net negative for market access.

Crypto.title: Trillions in institutional money to flow into bitcoin, says Bitwise's Matt Hougan
Crypto.reason: An institutional-adoption narrative from a major index/asset manager reinforces demand expectations for BTC/ETF flows — bullish but opinion‑based, so moderate relevance.
